cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only holding the map. The car won't start, so I've chosen us a walking route. Lovely chance to stretch our legs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better, a free shower. I'll take us through the park; no stuffy bus for us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, the shower's reached your socks. I'll take us along the puddles so both feet get a turn. We'll arrive washed from top to toe.

reason: Ground S06 in a modest practical role that decides sequence, spending, evaluation or route. Preserve responsive exact Drive causality and remove detached outcome explanations; avoid adding facts only a narrator could supply.
